notes: All 380 fixtures come from the ESPN ita.1 scoreboard feed (Tier 2), read one date at a time for every date in its 2026-27 calendar (82 dates, 22 Aug 2026 - 30 May 2027). Checks passed: 20 clubs, each 19 home and 19 away; every ordered pair exactly once; 10 matches and 20 different clubs in every matchday. The second half is not a mirror of the first (Serie A's asymmetric calendar).

Matchday numbers follow the date blocks (MD9 27-29 Oct and MD18 5-7 Jan 2027 are midweek rounds; from MD20, 17 Jan 2027, one date per matchday); legaseriea.it's schedule articles (Tier 1) give the same matchday for every result and for MD9-12.

Kick-off times: ESPN times (timeValid) for MD1-19 (to 11 Jan 2027); legaseriea.it's official times for MD9-12 agree with ESPN for every match (including the 25 Sep changes to MD12), and its two published MD13-14 times (Como v Juventus, Lazio v Atalanta) too. MD20-38 have one date per matchday in ESPN with time TBD: stored on that Sunday at 14:00 UTC (13:00 UTC from 28 Mar 2027, 15:00 Italian time) with timeConfirmed false.

Results MD1-8 (80): ESPN (goals) plus legaseriea.it's club pages (Tier 1) for 79; Udinese 0-2 AC Milan (25 Oct, not yet on legaseriea.it) is ESPN plus Sky Sports. Every score, date and matchday agrees. Sky's table (25 Oct) matches every club's record. Goals from ESPN's feed (no half-time scores).

Table: 3 relegated (18th-20th; Sky's table key), European places as for the Premier League (Sky: Champions League 1-4, Europa League 5, Conference League qualifying 6). Tie-break: points-h2h. legaseriea.it's own 2026-27 rule wasn't readable; Sky Sport Italia (sport.sky.it, May 2025) gives head-to-head points, head-to-head goal difference, goal difference, goals scored, then lots, with a play-off for the title or 17th place. Check before the end of the season.
